psychological_meaning: Fiord, a muted grayish-blue, evokes feelings of tranquility, stability, and sophistication. It suggests reliability and trustworthiness, often associated with a sense of calm and introspection. Its understated nature can also convey a sense of formality and professionalism, while hinting at creativity beneath the surface.
